meta.name: Zane Lamprey Ski Patrol
meta.description: Comedian Zane Lamprey charms audiences with hilarious anecdotes from shooting his TV shows "Three Sheets" and "Drinking Made Easy", which he pitched drunk to Mark Cuban. He also shares the invaluable advice he got from George Clooney, the brutal truth he got from his wife, and how he met his first Ski Patrol.
